method: Load the development route; install an onRender counter; focus the named input; type the exact four characters with Puppeteer keyboard input; wait 700 ms so the debounce and query render settle; aggregate render.count by component name.

opdDaySearch.note: The browser owns physical typing after the change. React still renders the route for the settled query and its result.

patientPhoneDuplicateCheck.note: The retained parent render is the field's first dirty-state transition. A second four-character segment rendered PatientPhoneDuplicateWarning six times and did not render PatientForm or FormProvider.

limits: Counts are development instrumentation, not production wall-clock latency.
The local seed has no patient matches, so the duplicate query and empty warning path ran; populated warning rendering was source-reviewed but not measured.
The OPD route had no appointment rows, so result-table rendering cost was not measured.
